newsitem.title: USA: Ball to sell aerosol business, sees gain.
newsitem.headline: Ball to sell aerosol business, sees gain.

text.p: Ball Corp said Monday it had completed the sale of its interest in a glass manufacturer and had agreed to sell its aerosol can manufacturing assets.

Ball said it completed the previously announced sale of its 42 percent interest in Ball-Foster Glass Container Co L.L.C. for more than $190 million to Compagnie de Saint-Gobain. This completes Ball's exit from the glass container manufacturing industry.
Ball said it will report a fourth quarter after-tax gain of about $10 million, or $0.33 a share, from the sale of its interest in Ball-Foster.

Ball also said it will exit the aerosol can manufacturing business by selling its Cincinnati manufacturing plant and certain other assets to BWAY Corp for about $36 million. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter, contingent on required regulatory filings, it said.

Ball produces rigid metal and plastic containers, largely for foods and beverages, and provides aerospace and other technologies and services to government and commercial customers. It reported 1995 sales of $2.6 billion.
